description: For fixed supplied compilers \(c,b\) of \(\psi\), the two chosen indices \(q_N,q_M\) simultaneously yield primitive-recursive selectors \(n(e,H)=s(q_N,\langle e,\operatorname{code}(H)\rangle)\) and \(m(H)=s(q_M,\operatorname{code}(H))\). For all \(e,H,z\), \(\varphi_{n(e,H)}(z)\simeq\varphi_e(z)\) if \(b(n(e,H))\notin B(H)\), and it is undefined otherwise; \(\varphi_{m(H)}(z)\) equals one if \(b(m(H))\in B(H)\), and is undefined otherwise. All membership tests concern translated names.
